attributes.law_screen: offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web: APPLIED as the primary conversion form throughout (level_data/Player/AudioDataLayout, all offsetof() on the original raw pointer, no typed intermediate) -- held byte-identical on every one of the 5 EXACT functions touched. declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast / multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing v2: screened; deliberately NOT used -- AudioSetupLevelStreams's lvl2 pointer feeds 4 nearby AudioDataLayout fields (nareas/stereo/stream/nparts) in one function, exactly the danger zone both laws describe, so a typed AudioDataLayout* alias was never attempted; offsetof-on-raw-pointer was used instead per those laws' own stated preference, and the function held real 52 exactly through the whole conversion, consistent with the laws' prediction. lwzu-idiom-web-retention: screened; AudioAmbientUpdate's p=(u8*)gPlayers+poff outer walk and the t-accumulated powerup scan are exactly this law's target pattern -- kept both walks completely unchanged (no typed intermediate introduced, no dead local removed), only renamed the literal displacements, and the function's pre-existing WebFrank patch held. offsetof-fused-immediate-counter: applicable to the t-accumulated powerup walk (p+t+CONST folds to one immediate); used the law's proven form (offsetof(Player,powerup)+offsetof(PlayerPowerup,specialflags) as a single additive addend), held byte-identical. pointer-walk-array-index-regression / recomputed-index-array-form-safe: screened AND RE-TESTED on lbl_80257630's joff/koff walk (accumulator-carried via `joff += 4` in the for-clause, not recomputed fresh from the loop counter) -- converting to lbl_80257630[j]/[k] broke the whole object build (see negative_finding); reverted, confirming the accumulator/recomputed distinction extends to plain named arrays with zero struct-field involvement, not just struct-embedded ones. scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form / offsetof-fused-immediate-counter's array-member boundary / offsetof-overturns-typed-alias-caps / large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression / walked-base-symbol-identity: screened, none applicable -- no adjacent scalar read+write pair on one field, no array-typed struct MEMBER as a base (gCurLevel and p are both plain pointer variables/parameters, not ->array fields), no pre-existing cap being re-attempted on this TU, and every touched function is far under the 4000-insn fuzzy-arbitration threshold so real/insns were checked directly.

Also deliberately left non-field raw casts alone as legitimate structless-pool forms per AGENTS.md (not census-counted by the debt regex since they lack a leading dereference-star, but noted for completeness): AudioWithName's T/T16 reinterpretations of the shared sSpeechNameBuf scratch buffer, AudioBuildMusicName's (s32*)(buf+off) scratch-buffer cursor, and AudioAmbientUpdate's (u8*)((u32)gPlayers+poff+t) argument to fn_800552A4 -- this last one is NOT a powerup-array pointer (poff+t lands 0x130 bytes before the powerup block that offsetof(Player,powerup) resolves for the sibling +304/+316 reads in the same statement), so no GC-verified field name applies; renaming it would have been a guess, not a resolution.
attributes.negative_finding: Converting lbl_80257630's accumulator-walked array access (`*(u32*)((u8*)lbl_80257630 + joff)`, joff incremented via `joff += 4` in the for-loop's own increment clause, in lockstep with a real loop-counter j) to plain indexed form (`lbl_80257630[j]`) changed AudioAmbientUpdate's compiled instruction stream enough that the function's PRE-EXISTING WebFrank equivalence patch (config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json, keyed by an input-object hash) no longer matched -- webfrank.py raised 'input hash ... != expected ...' and ninja aborted the WHOLE sounds.o build, which defake_gate.py then reported as all 33 functions in the TU 'vanished from object' (a build-failure cascade, not a per-function score regression). Reverted immediately; GATE OK confirmed restoration to baseline. This is a stronger, build-breaking variant of claim.law.pointer-walk-array-index-regression's accumulator-vs-recomputed distinction, and the first confirmation that the distinction holds even with ZERO struct fields in play (a bare named u32[4] global, walked by an accumulator byte-offset local rather than the loop counter directly) -- and a reminder that a WebFrank-patched EXACT function's fragility is not limited to the specific bytes the patch names; any codegen-visible change nearby can invalidate the patch's input hash and fail the whole object, not just that function.
attributes.new_local_struct: AudioDataLayout, declared file-local in sounds.c (near the top, before first use) to name level_data.audio's pointee fields (Xbox PDB audio_data: bank[16]@0x00, entersnd@0x10, hitsnd@0x12, namesnd@0x14, stream[16]@0x18, nareas@0x28, stereo@0x2A, nparts[8]@0x2C). GC offsets are NOT independently cross-TU verified the way level_data's are; evidence is AudioSetupLevelStreams's own internal self-consistency (nareas used as both a >1 gate and an index clamp bound; stereo read once as a channel count passed straight to AudioStreamPlay; nparts indexed by the stream-state selector with a matching *2 stride for its s16 element size; stream read as a %s name/prefix string) plus sounds_evt.c's independent +18 (hitsnd) access off the identical gCurLevel->audio base (out of this pass's TU-exclusive scope, so left unconverted there, but corroborates the layout). Used offsetof()-only on the raw u8* pointer throughout -- never instantiated as a typed AudioDataLayout* -- per claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing's warning against a typed alias on a base feeding 3+ nearby fields.
